description: Reusable authored-pose direction for conjurer player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies elemental crystal-focus choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: elemental, sweeping, balanced, and adaptive, with crystal-focus leverage, grounded stance changes, and distinct earth, fire, ice, or nature gestures
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's robes, crystal staff or focus, elemental ornaments, jewelry, and exact item count. Keep exactly one depicted focus in its original hand; never duplicate crystals, swap equipment, or turn effects into permanent gear.
identity.magicRule: Use only the elemental types and palette established in the portrait. Each action shows one compact, readable element at a time, visibly sourced from the crystal focus or casting hand.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, robes, crystal focus, elemental ornaments, palette, proportions, and equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact elemental-mage silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered conjurer in an element-balanced stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall conjurer motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, robes, crystal focus, palette, proportions, and elemental ornaments. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A measured breathing loop shifts stance around the crystal focus while one tiny established element alternately brightens and rests.
idle.effectRule: Only a thumb-sized pulse of one portrait-established element is permitted.

weight shifts forward and free hand opens

centered elemental midpoint

balanced stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A coherent alternating walk uses real leg compression, focus counter-motion, and responsive robe movement.
walk.effectRule: No active elemental spell; the crystal may retain a faint steady glow.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact with focus balanced
left leg compressed as robes gather
passing pose with right knee advancing
right foot reaches while staff or focus counter-swings
right foot forward contact

attack.motionDirection: The focus pulls back, free hand selects one element, a planted sweep drives a compact elemental contact, and the body follows through into balance.
attack.effectRule: One short earth, fire, ice, or nature accent established by the portrait may mark contact; no mixed-element storm or detached large projectile.

hurt.motionDirection: An impact breaks balance into a sharp flinch, scattered elemental fragments, focus-assisted stagger, grounded brace, and calm recovery.
hurt.effectRule: A few small fragments of the established element may disperse; no gore, blood, full-body tint, or uncontrolled field effect.

sharp flinch with focus pulled close

death.motionDirection: The focused element extinguishes, knees buckle, the body sinks beside the crystal focus, tips sideways, and settles in a fully fallen rest.
death.effectRule: Elemental light fades without eruption, gore, blood, dismemberment, or rigid rotation; keep the focus singular.

cast.motionDirection: The focus plants, free hand names one element, crystal energy rises, both arms shape a compact form, release it forward, and restore elemental balance.
cast.effectRule: Shape and release one compact portrait-established element from the crystal or hand; never combine unrelated elements or cover the body.

victory.motionDirection: The conjurer recognizes victory, raises the crystal, guides one small element through a controlled orbit, plants the focus, and holds a harmonious finish.
victory.effectRule: One compact established element may orbit the focus; no mixed-element spectacle.
